recipe:
set -e
x=$(mktemp -d) && tar xzf results/published/catalog_processing/xi_scan/xi_sweep_bundle.tar.gz -C $x
o=$(mktemp -d)
versions=$(python src/papers/bmodes/scripts/catalog_versions.py size_cut applied --nonfiducial)
for ver in $versions; do
  python src/papers/bmodes/scripts/pure_eb_modes.py \
    --xi-reporting "$x/$ver"_xi_minsep=1.0_maxsep=250.0_nbins=20_npatch=1.txt \
    --xi-integration "$x/$ver"_xi_minsep=0.5_maxsep=300.0_nbins=1000_npatch=1.txt \
    --integration-method fixed_operator \
    --integration-limits fine_grid_extent \
    --rebinning-weights npairs \
    --out-file "$o/$ver"_pure_eb_data.npz
done
tar czf results/published/catalog_processing/pure_eb_sweep.tar.gz -C $o .
